defect: 'batuhan ng lubid' means rope-throwing, not a pulling contest; the question names the wrong game
tl:
Sino ang nananalo sa batuhan ng lubid?

Ang panig na may mas malakas na hila ang nananalo at nakakahatak sa kabila!
en:
Who wins in a game of tug-of-war?

The side that pulls with greater force wins and drags the other side!
